samples.label: Another learner video: only the first folds
samples.description: A re-encoding of Crane.ogv (CC BY 3.0, Tavin, via Wikimedia Commons). It covers only the first 25 s, so most later folds are missing; see which ones the check finds.
samples.credit: Crane.ogv by Tavin, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Crane.ogv)

samples.label: The demonstration cut up and re-joined out of order
samples.description: Derived from OrigamiCrane.ogv (CC BY 3.0, Tavin) by re-joining its four quarters as 1, 3, 2, 4. See which folds the check can no longer find in sequence.
samples.credit: Derived from OrigamiCrane.ogv by Tavin, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:OrigamiCrane.ogv)
